verdict.rationale: Dropbox provides event primitives: webhooks notify an app of any change in Dropbox (dropbox-docs-4, dropbox-docs-28), and the Files API can then act on files and folders (dropbox-docs-3). The user has to write and host their own handler to turn these into rules. The only built-in automatic behaviour in evidence is Dropbox Sign's fixed auto-save of signed documents (dropbox-docs-16), which is not user-defined. Missing for 10: a native rule or automation builder (trigger → condition → action), user-configurable event triggers without custom code, AI-driven or AI-configured automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
